title: DNA Extraction with Heater Shaker - Part 1
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample added to heater shaker (HS) plate

steps.title: Prepare CSV files & volumes
steps.instruction: Create up to three CSV files per source plate, each beginning with a header row `barcode, rack_num, sample_rack_row, sample_rack_col, plate_row, plate_col, dna_extract_row, dna_extract_col`. Fill sample rows starting at line 2. Load no more than 90 samples onto a 96‑well heater‑shaker plate, reserving six wells for controls. For reagents 4 (columns 4‑5), 5 (columns 6‑7) and 6 (columns 8‑9), split the total calculated reagent volume equally between the two columns. The number of CSV files must equal the number of source plates used.

substeps.instruction: Create up to three CSV files per source plate
Enter sample locations starting at row 2
Limit samples to 90 per HS plate (6 wells for controls)
Split reagent volumes equally for column pairs 4‑5, 6‑7, 8‑9

steps.title: Add samples to HS plate
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample from the source plates into the corresponding wells of the heater‑shaker (HS) 96‑well plate according to the CSV mapping.

steps.title: Add controls to HS plate
steps.instruction: Add the six control reactions to the designated wells of the HS plate.

steps.title: Load 50 µL reagent (col 1)
steps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL of the reagent from column 1 of the reagent plate into every sample and control well of the HS plate.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C, 2000 RPM
steps.instruction: Place the HS plate on the heater shaker set to 37 °C and 2000 RPM and incubate for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Load 60 µL reagent (col 2)
steps.instruction: Dispense 60 µL of the reagent from column 2 of the reagent plate into each sample and control well of the HS plate.

steps.title: Heat at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Set the heater shaker to 55 °C (no shaking required) and incubate the HS plate for 30 minutes.
